SELECT 
    cc.credscore,
    CASE 
        WHEN cc.credscore BETWEEN 300 AND 579 THEN 'Poor'
        WHEN cc.credscore BETWEEN 580 AND 669 THEN 'Fair'
        WHEN cc.credscore BETWEEN 670 AND 739 THEN 'Good'
        WHEN cc.credscore BETWEEN 740 AND 799 THEN 'Very Good'
        WHEN cc.credscore BETWEEN 800 AND 850 THEN 'Excellent'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS credit_category,
    cr.clientref,
    cr.gendlabel,
    cr.maritalform,
    cr.agespan,
    cr.resdform,
    ei.joblabel,
    ei.indsector,
    ei.mthincome,
    ea.mthexp,
    ea.networth,
    ba.bouncecount,
    ba.fraudrisk
FROM credit_and_compliance cc
JOIN bank_and_transactions ba ON cc.compbankref = ba.bankexpref
JOIN expenses_and_assets ea ON ba.bankexpref = ea.expemplref
JOIN employment_and_income ei ON ea.expemplref = ei.emplcoreref
JOIN core_record cr ON ei.emplcoreref = cr.coreregistry
ORDER BY cc.credscore;
